title: Dragonair's Lakes Are Filled With Offerings

direction.premise: Dragonair is associated with weather control, and lakes where it lives are filled with offerings.
direction.audiencePromise: See why people venerate Dragonair, and where belief ends and proof begins.
direction.openLoop: Why would people leave offerings beside lakes where Dragonair lives?
direction.payoff: The lake offerings turn Dragonair's claimed weather power into visible human belief.
direction.engagementQuestion: Are the offerings proof of power, or proof of belief?

voice.instructions: Warm and quick, like a knowledgeable fan sharing an eerie detail. Stress offerings, weather, and belief. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: PRISTINE LAKES, OFFERINGS
scenes.narration: Dragonair's lakes look pristine, yet people leave offerings there.
scenes.caption: THE LAKE ISN'T EMPTY

scenes.headline: GIFTS FOR WEATHER POWER
scenes.narration: People fill those lakes with offerings, believing Dragonair controls weather.
scenes.caption: THE OFFERINGS HAVE A REASON

scenes.headline: A WEATHER-CONTROLLING ENTITY
scenes.narration: Agricultural peoples venerate Dragonair as an entity that controls weather.
scenes.caption: VENERATION BUILT AROUND WEATHER

scenes.headline: BRIGHTENING CHANGES WEATHER
scenes.narration: When Dragonair's whole body brightens, the weather changes instantly.
scenes.caption: THE WEATHER RESPONDS TO ITS AURA

scenes.headline: THEY SAY IT CONTROLS WEATHER
scenes.narration: People say Dragonair controls weather when its body takes on an aura.
scenes.caption: THE LAKE SHOWS BELIEF

scenes.headline: POWER OR BELIEF?
scenes.narration: Do the gifts honor real power, or reflect a powerful belief?
scenes.caption: WHICH SIDE ARE YOU ON?
